h2.purpose: One per section, under its plotted rule.

label.purpose: Condensed caps for meta, captions, and field labels.

data.purpose: Ruler, redlines, HTTP, counts. Never decoration.

shadows.name: peek
shadows.purpose: The floating project preview; the only element that sits above the sheet.

motion.name: plot
motion.purpose: Straightedge (QA): even, deliberate travel that lands exactly. Wipes, rules, redlines.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: Straightedge snaps: stamps, nodes, magnets returning.

motion.name: curve
motion.purpose: French curve (Frontend): long fluid deceleration. Rises, blooms, glides.

motion.name: theme-print
motion.value: View Transition clip, 820ms plot (QA) / 1000ms circle bloom from the switch (Frontend)

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Ink block; the lens's field wipes in on hover.

components.name: Trace Tag
components.description: A stack item that traces its tool across projects when pressed.

components.name: Title-block Field
components.description: A labelled cell in the contact sheet grid.

narrative.overview: An engineering drawing sheet for one person who both builds interfaces and breaks them. Whiteprint in light, cyanotype blueprint in dark. The persona switch chooses whose hand you see: the checker's highlighter and red pencil, or the drafter's cobalt ink.
keyCharacteristics: Archivo on its width axis carries every role
Two motion grammars: straightedge (QA) and French curve (Frontend)
Evidence restated from real project data

rules.name: The Lens Rule
rules.body: --accent is a field, --accent-line is a stroke or text; components read the lens from html[data-persona].

rules.name: The Highlighter Rule
rules.body: Yellow sits behind navy ink only.

rules.name: The Grammar Rule
rules.body: Every animation is either straightedge or French curve; nothing uses a generic fade-up.

dos: Do keep content visible by default and give reduced motion a real alternative.
Do restate evidence from project blurbs, never embellish it.
donts: Don't use pills, glass, gradient text, or decorative circles.
Don't use the mono face as decoration.
